chat.author: Andrew Stone
chat.text: pcUpds and state sync (pcRpts) are often correlated, so how can they be parallelized?

chat.author: Dhruv Dhody
chat.text: even the seperation of PSTs seems complicated

chat.author: Andrew Stone
chat.text:
i've commented before i don't really see the value of this for PCE<->PCC in the classical router case. The volume of data between a PCE and PCC is really not much. 
However for the pce-state-sync it becomes a bit more applicable

chat.author: Andrew Stone
chat.text: and even in the PCE<->PCE case i'm not sure you'd want to parallelize by PST or certain messages, but rather differentiate information on a per PCC basis or for 'global' information exchange

chat.author: Andrew Stone
chat.text: pcRpt after pcClose sounds like a fun time

chat.author: Dhruv Dhody
chat.text: saying PCRpt and PCInitiate as low priority ???

chat.author: Samuel Sidor
chat.text: Some ofthose still requires more discussion, but I personally see added value in both - having multiple logical streams (e.g. potentially to allow different capabilities) and also to potentially prioritize some LSPs over other LSPs even from processing POV (high priority vs low priority queue)

chat.author: Andrew Stone
chat.text: Samuel trying to interweave different messages that effect the same LSP is going to risk out-of-order logical processing, when the messages are pretty stateful, will it not ?

chat.author: Samuel Sidor
chat.text: Yes, that part still requires more work/clarifications (so not prioritizing per message type, at least not between stateful messages), but more on per LSP bases for example.

chat.author: Boris Khasanov
chat.text: how to prevent possible races?

chat.author: Andrew Stone
chat.text: PCE<->PCE multi channel, and how to orchestrate and parallelize information exchange on a per-pcc key basis seems like a situation that can benefit from something like this and have a feasible solution, and TBH it's one of those items I feel like the state-sync draft would run into during-experimentation. i.e time to recover and resync large environments
